Description: ProjectionMatrix P maps the VICON laboratory frame (mm, the frame of the VICON motion files) to image pixels of the clips of this view (x right, y down, origin top-left, full image size): [u w, v w, w]^T = P [X, Y, Z, 1]^T; no lens distortion. Calibration uses the NumValidTrials trials of the video that are vicon_valid and valid in this view, with VICON markers matched to white marker blobs. SplitFitReprojectionErrorPx: a camera fitted (DLT and robust refinement) on alternate trials (alternate frames when the video has one valid trial) and tested on the others: TrainMedian on its fitting pairs, HeldOutMedian and HeldOutP90 on the NumHeldOutPairs pairs of the other trials. ProjectionMatrix is then refitted on all NumMarkerBlobPairs pairs, so the held-out errors estimate the accuracy of the procedure, not of this matrix on unseen data. CalibrationOK = HeldOutMedian <= 8 px with NumHeldOutPairs >= 30 and at least 99 % of the video's VICON marker samples in front of the camera (MarkersInFrontShare); labels2d and tracks3d use only cameras with CalibrationOK. PixelsPerMm: median local image scale of ProjectionMatrix at the matched markers. Runs: every run (valid or not) whose clip of this view comes from the calibrated video. A session has one entry per calibrated source video.
